## Where things stand
The real replay is done: PR #233 is merged, the `replay-1` job completed and wrote 18,442,107 events to `events.replay.v3` (3,118 schema-v2 rejects to S3). The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is still running (~61% at last check, 14.9M rows in `events_v3` versus ~20.5M expected), so the incident must stay open until hour-by-hour counts match within 1% tolerance. The fork PR #241 must be ignored; Daniel owns the CI dedup-key check. (source: ses-rp-2, ses-rp-1)

- [in-progress] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 reading `events.replay.v3`, last observed at 61% (hours 00–14 done, 15–23 in progress) (source: ses-rp-2, r2-06)
- [next-step] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, then compare ClickHouse `events_v3` counts hour by hour against expectations with a 1% tolerance (source: ses-rp-2, r2-08)
- [next-step] Close the incident only once counts match; customers (Fernhill, Orbitly) were told data is back by Thursday (source: ses-rp-2, r2-07)
- [next-step] Daniel runs the CI check that fails if the dedup key builder can truncate; no other fix for this incident (source: ses-rp-1, src-slack-incident)
- [failed-attempt] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit) because the namespace quota is capped; 5k batches work at ~310 MiB peak (source: ses-rp-1, r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Whether to confirm the exact restoration date with Orbitly, whose board report depends on it (source: src-zendesk-orbitly)
- [decision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3` and never produce to `events.v3` directly from the replay tool; the aggregator reads the replay topic with `--backfill` (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [decision] Use 5k batches and do not change the memory limit (source: r1-04)
- [decision] PR #233 was approved and merged by Daniel; the real replay was authorized for the same window with batch 5k (source: r2-01)
- [decision] Do not close the incident until the counts match (source: r2-07)
- [decision] Ignore PR #241; Daniel does the CI check (source: r2-09)
